text: Qualified certificates for electronic signatures shall contain:
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: a
text: an indication, at least in a form suitable for automated processing, that the certificate has been issued as a qualified certificate for electronic signature;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: b
text: a set of data unambiguously representing the qualified trust service provider issuing the qualified certificates including at least, the Member State in which that provider is established and:
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

text: for a legal person: the name and, where applicable, registration number as stated in the official records,
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

text: for a natural person: the person’s name;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: c
text: at least the name of the signatory, or a pseudonym; if a pseudonym is used, it shall be clearly indicated;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: d
text: electronic signature validation data that corresponds to the electronic signature creation data;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: e
text: details of the beginning and end of the certificate’s period of validity;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: f
text: the certificate identity code, which must be unique for the qualified trust service provider;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: g
text: the advanced electronic signature or advanced electronic seal of the issuing qualified trust service provider;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: h
text: the location where the certificate supporting the advanced electronic signature or advanced electronic seal referred to in point (g) is available free of charge;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: i
text: the location of the services that can be used to enquire about the validity status of the qualified certificate;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: j
text: where the electronic signature creation data related to the electronic signature validation data is located in a qualified electronic signature creation device, an appropriate indication of this, at least in a form suitable for automated processing.
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

text: Qualified electronic signature creation devices shall ensure, by appropriate technical and procedural means, that at least:
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: a
text: the confidentiality of the electronic signature creation data used for electronic signature creation is reasonably assured;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: b
text: the electronic signature creation data used for electronic signature creation can practically occur only once;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: c
text: the electronic signature creation data used for electronic signature creation cannot, with reasonable assurance, be derived and the electronic signature is reliably protected against forgery using currently available technology;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: d
text: the electronic signature creation data used for electronic signature creation can be reliably protected by the legitimate signatory against use by others.
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

text: Qualified electronic signature creation devices shall not alter the data to be signed or prevent such data from being presented to the signatory prior to signing.
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

text: Generating or managing electronic signature creation data on behalf of the signatory may only be done by a qualified trust service provider.
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

text: Without prejudice to point (d) of point 1, qualified trust service providers managing electronic signature creation data on behalf of the signatory may duplicate the electronic signature creation data only for back-up purposes provided the following requirements are met:
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: a
text: the security of the duplicated datasets must be at the same level as for the original datasets;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

label: b
text: the number of duplicated datasets shall not exceed the minimum needed to ensure continuity of the service.
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf
